title: Payroll Administrator (f/m)
description:
We are recruiting for a leading global financial services firm specializing in asset servicing, custody banking, and investment management, supporting institutional clients worldwide.

Responsibilities:

• Cooperate with external vendors and service providers to ensure smooth payroll operations.
• Manage the employee sick leave process, including recording absences in the system and coordinating the required supporting documentation.
• Review payroll calculations for approximately 3,000 employees, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
• Respond to and resolve employee queries related to salary payments, payroll calculations, and payroll processing.
• Work closely with the Payroll Manager and other team members to achieve shared goals, identify development opportunities, and support continuous learning.
• Provide a high level of customer service by taking ownership of assigned tasks, addressing issues proactively, and ensuring employee needs are met.
• Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes and service delivery, and actively contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
• Build and maintain positive relationships with internal and external stakeholders through professional, helpful, and timely communication.
• Support the Payroll Manager and Payroll Team with additional tasks, activities, and projects as required.

Qualifications:

• Knowledge of Polish labour law, particularly working time regulations, as well as Polish tax and social security regulations, would be an advantage.
• Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills, with the ability to work confidently with data and spreadsheets.
• A technical and analytical mindset, with an interest in payroll systems and processes.
• Good problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and take ownership of issues.
• Familiarity with time and attendance systems would be an advantage.
• Good written and spoken English communication skills.
• A collaborative approach, attention to detail, and a strong commitment to providing excellent customer service.

What we offer:

• 12-month contract with the potential for enriching experiences and professional growth
• Salary: 41,66-44,64 PLN gross/h
• international environment, open communication and continuous learning
• hybrid work (4 days a week from office)

We are the world's leading company dedicated to providing HR solutions, offering temporary and permanent staffing and outsourcing services in all sectors.
